turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve been feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially toward the end of the day, to the point that it’s hard to take care of myself. I’ve also noticed some mild double vision.
Have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids, or any difficulty
Patient: I haven’t noticed any eyelid drooping, but the double vision seems to come and go and is worse when I’m more tired. I haven’t had any trouble swallowing or speaking either.
Have you noticed any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing,
No, I haven’t noticed any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing. My weakness is mainly in my body and I feel it more later in the day. I can still swallow and speak normally.
Are you experiencing weakness in any specific muscles, like your arms

Patient: Yes—my arms and legs both feel weak, and it’s worse as the day goes on; I just feel drained and have trouble doing my usual tasks by late afternoon. It’s more like generalized exhaustion than one specific muscle group.
Are you experiencing any numbness, tingling, or changes in

No, I haven’t noticed any numbness or tingling, just a progressive drained weakness and fatigue as the day goes on. I also don’t think there are any clear changes in sensation—it's mainly how strong I feel.
Have you had any recent illnesses, infections, or fe
Patient: Yes, I’ve had several illnesses recently, and I’ve been traveling and hiking and camping. I’m not sure if they were all related, but I’ve had ongoing fatigue since those episodes.
Have you noticed any rashes on your skin, particularly a target

“No, I haven’t noticed any new rashes on my skin—no target-like spots. I’m mainly dealing with the drained weakness that builds later in the day, along with the mild double vision that seems worse when I’m more tired.”
Have you experienced any joint pain, swelling, or muscle aches
Patient: I haven’t had any joint swelling or significant muscle aches, but I do feel generally drained and weak later in the day. I wouldn’t say my joints hurt—it's more a whole-body fatigue.
Have you noticed any changes in your bowel or bladder habits,

“No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my bowel or bladder habits—everything seems normal there. It’s mainly the drained weakness and fatigue that build toward the end of the day, plus the mild double vision that comes and goes with tiredness.”
Have you noticed any changes in your vision other than the double

Patient: My vision is mostly the same aside from the mild double vision, and it tends to get worse when I’m tired and improves after I rest. I haven’t noticed any loss of vision or new blurry spots. Patient: Also, I don’t have trouble speaking or swallowing, and I don’t feel like my breathing is affected—this is mainly the whole-body weakness and fatigue later in the day.
